# Cozymeal

> > Cozymeal is a culinary experience marketplace connecting food enthusiasts with cooking classes, private chefs, food tours, and culinary gifts.

Cozymeal operates across major cities including Los Angeles, San Diego, and Jacksonville, featuring renowned chefs like Chef Jace, Chef Marty, and Chef Kumi. The platform offers comprehensive foodie experiences from hands-on cooking classes to personalized private chef services and curated food tours.
